committees.name: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee

dimensions.assessment: Affects Department of Labor personnel, employee ownership organizations, employee stock ownership plan sponsors, and participants.
dimensions.evidence: representatives of employee ownership organizations... employees stock ownership plan sponsors and participants

dimensions.assessment: Creates new administrative offices, councils, advisory positions, reporting duties, and dispute assistance functions.
dimensions.evidence: Secretary of Labor shall establish the Office of Employee Ownership in the Department of Labor

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes compensation for council members and the advocate, and such sums as necessary, without detailing exact overall totals.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary to carry out subsection (d).

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 (ERISA) by adding multiple new entities, advocacy roles, and reporting requirements.
dimensions.evidence: Subtitle A of title III of the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 is amended by adding at the end the following

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent offices and ongoing annual reporting requirements.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than December 31 of each calendar year... submit a report

missing_information: The precise total budget appropriations required to fund the new offices and positions.
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes an Office of Employee Ownership, an Advisory Council on Employee Ownership, and an Advocate for Employee Ownership within the Department of Labor, and expands ERISA advisory council membership.
